sop: SOP-PR-030 Master production and control records (synthetic)

ranking.title: 211.110 Sampling and testing of in-process materials and drug products.

rows.text: To assure uniformity from batch to batch, master production and control records for each drug product, including each batch size thereof, shall be prepared, dated, and signed (full signature, handwritten) by one person and independently checked, dated, and signed by a second person.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To describe how the master manufacturing and packaging record of each product is written, checked, approved and issued, so that every batch is made the same way.

3. Writing and approval

3.1 Production writes a master record for each product and each batch size, on the template in this SOP. 3.2 The author signs it in full by hand and dates it. A second person from QA checks it independently against the product's registered formula, then signs and dates it.

4. Contents

4.1 The master record states the product name, strength and dosage form, the name and quantity of each active ingredient per tablet or capsule, and the target weight of one tablet or capsule fill. 4.2 It lists every component by material code and name, with the grade where the grade matters (for example micronised), and the quantity of each per batch in kilograms or grams. Any range allowed for a component is stated with its reason. 4.3 It gives the theoretical yield of the batch with the lowest and highest yield accepted; a yield outside these limits is investigated under SOP-QA-
